title: Contract closure velocity grid — Nov 2026 sprint
content:
Columns: Account, ARR USD, Contract Start, Contract End, Days to Expiry, Renewal Probability (%), CS Owner, Last Contact, Next Step, Playbook Action, Concession Plan, Risk Level, Notes

Rows:
Redwood Retail Corp, 180000, 2023-12-01, 2026-12-15, 40, 75, Maya Chen, 2026-10-20, Exec sponsor touch + pricing recap, 1) run QBR; 2) customer health report; 3) offer 1-yr discount if signed by 2026-12-01, Standard 10% annual renewal, Medium, "Customer loves latency improvements; procurement cycles long. Finance asked for invoice term change — coordinate with sales ops."

VectorLogix, 420000, 2024-01-10, 2026-12-05, 30, 55, Diego Alvarez, 2026-10-28, Arrange technical deep-dive (latency/cost tradeoffs), 1) technical ROI deck; 2) propose Dedicated capacity pilot, Possible one-time credit (up to $25k), High, "High commercial value but churn risk due to competing roadmap. Need CSM+SE alignment."

Beacon Health Network, 95,000, 2022-11-01, 2026-11-25, 20, 85, Priya Patel, 2026-11-01, Send renewal proposal + contract amendment, 1) offer 2-year price lock; 2) include compliance addendum, No concession (aim to upsell Optimize), Low, "Regulated; prefers Private deployment. Legal waiting on SOC2 clause. If delays, push to escalation."

Atlas Commerce, 1,200,000, 2021-12-15, 2027-01-10, 56, 95, Aiden Park, 2026-09-12, Confirm expansion ARR numbers and signature timeline, 1) executive QBR + roadmap sync; 2) propose Dedicated pool for peak season, Custom commercial (annual prepay + SLA), Low, "Strategic enterprise. Primary blocker: procurement timeline tied to fiscal year close."

NimbleChat Inc, 60,000, 2025-02-01, 2026-11-20, 15, 40, Maya Chen, 2026-10-30, Run churn-risk playbook: usage dip investigation, 1) usage spike analysis; 2) targeted feature enablement; 3) offer 3-month extension at 5% discount, Small concession to retain, High, "Product adoption dropped after feature deprecation. Needs PM involvement."

QuickShip Logistics, 360,000, 2023-07-01, 2026-12-30, 55, 65, Diego Alvarez, 2026-10-22, Align on volume forecasts + pricing, 1) volume-tiered pricing proposal; 2) autoscale runbook, Standard 7% renewal, Medium, "Seasonal spikes — propose burst credits to avoid SLA complaints."

---

Operational notes and quick formulas (not linked):
- Days to Expiry = (Contract End - today) — update daily in sheet. (sheet formula placeholder: =DAYS([@Contract End], TODAY()))
- Weighted ARR calc (for sprint rollup): =SUMPRODUCT(ARR, Renewal Probability)/100 -> used in team forecast
- Sprint focus: close accounts with Days to Expiry < 45 and Probability > 50% first.

Playbook snippets (for CSMs to copy into outreach):
- "Executive refresh (10 min): two slides — 1) value realized (latency/cost savings), 2) proposal + ask. Ask: commit to 12 months by MM/DD to lock current pricing."
- "Technical re-risk: schedule 60-min SE session to present Dedicated vs Hosted TCO at customer's forecasted QPS. Bring quantized perf sheet."
- "Legal hold: if legal gating, request redline deadline and escalate to AE for commercial guarantee."

Unresolved items / To-dos (notes to self):
- Confirm Beacon Health SOC2 addendum owner (legal contact: AK).
- VectorLogix pilot sizing: need infra metrics from SE team (ticket: SE-411).
- NimbleChat PM sync scheduled? (no — send calendar invite)

Summary sprint targets (by EOD 2026-11-10):
- Target closed ARR: $540k (weighted) from accounts with Days to Expiry < 45.
- At-risk ARR to escalate to sales ops: $480k.

Metadata for internal tracking:
- Last run weighted-ARR snapshot: $1,045,000 (2026-11-02)
- Primary escalation path: CSM -> AE -> Sales Ops -> Legal -> Finance

Quick revision history (notes):
- 2026-11-02: initial draft and imported last quarter contract list (Maya)
- 2026-11-04: added VectorLogix risk notes + concession plan (Diego)
- 2026-11-05: Beacon Health compliance update (Priya)

Notes to self: keep this file compact; export canonical view to Confluence (CONFLUENCE-1234) once sprint closes.
